content:
monitor-bot: ALERT — ap-southeast3 control-plane health degrade. api_servers_unreachable=97%, gpu_node_evictions=sharp increase, tcp_syn_loss observed. dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/r/ap-southeast3 :rotating_light:

emma-oncall: Ack, starting triage. Paging net + srep. Creating incident doc.

sam-net: I’m seeing route withdrawals from the cloud edge for ap-southeast3. BGP updates show large-scale withdrawal of regional prefixes — traceroute => blackhole at provider-agg.

jia-sre: Confirming client telemetry: 75% of connections to ap-southeast3 failing TLS handshake. Automated region-failover tried but many sessions are pinned. We need traffic steering and cache warmup in target region.

luis-ops: Can enable dedicated burst pool in ap-east1 and eu-west1, but cost impact ~>$15k/day if sustained. Need approval to flip on emergency capacity.

emma-oncall: Do it. Use emergency budget; we need customer-facing stability. luis, spin up with conservative autoscale: min 20, max 200 for GPU pools.

sam-net: Contacted cloud provider NOC — ticket #CLOUD-8675309 opened. Their initial note: "investigating BGP flaps on provider transit, possible upstream route reflector instability." ETA unknown.

cloud-support-bot: Cloud provider status page updated: https://status.cloudprovider.example/incidents/8675309 — "Investigating networking".

jia-sre: Plan for immediate actions: 1) Enable smart-routing emergency-failover policy (non-disruptive) 2) Increase cross-region KV cache replication to warm target 3) Drain long-lived sessions from ap-southeast3 with 60s grace.

emma-oncall: Commands to run (copy/paste):
```
redwoodctl routing set --from ap-southeast3 --to ap-east1 --policy emergency-failover --drain 60s
redwoodctl pool scale --region ap-east1 --pool dedicated-gpu --min 20 --max 200
redwoodctl kv replicate --from ap-southeast3 --to ap-east1 --priority high
```

harper-pm: Noted. I’ll prep a short customer message (status page + email) once we confirm traffic shift. Need line on expected impact and ETA if provider gives one.

sam-net: Running targeted connectivity tests now: `mtr -c 10 ap-southeast3-gateway.cloudprovider.net` => packet loss at hop 6 consistently. Also seeing AS path prepends from upstream.

support-agent: Support queue shows a sharp spike in error-rate for ap-southeast3 tenants, many escalations from high-value customers. Posting a pinned note to the status page: "We are failing over traffic from ap-southeast3 while we investigate networking instability."

jia-sre: Executed routing set and pool scale. KV replication started (0 -> 12% warmed so far). Observed higher latency on failover target during warmup, but no errors after 30% warm.

emma-oncall: Good. Please run the smoke test matrix and post results: `smoke/all-regions --target ap-east1`

jia-sre: Smoke results: auth/login OK, inference basic path OK, streaming degraded but within SLO after retry logic. Will monitor token-cost surge due to retries.

luis-ops: Dedicated pools up, billing alerts set. Will keep capacity until provider confirms route stabilization.

sam-net: Cloud NOC says they saw a config propagation delay in one of their route reflectors — rolling restart on their side. They expect partial restoration in ~20-40 minutes. Ticket updated.

emma-oncall: Timeline & immediate notes: - Traffic shifted to ap-east1, eu-west1 as fallback - Dedicated burst capacity enabled - KV replication warming - Customers notified on status page - Cloud provider engaged (ticket CLOUD-8675309)

emma-oncall: Action owners: sam-net => follow cloud NOC + confirm route restores; jia-sre => monitor session health and cache warmup; luis-ops => watch costs and capacity; harper-pm => customer comms; support-agent => triage escalations.

monitor-bot: Incident channel created: #incident-ap-southeast3-1766000000. Paging rotation for next 2 hours.

harper-pm: I’ll draft the initial status update: "We detected networking instability impacting ap-southeast3. We’ve failed over traffic and enabled emergency capacity. We’re coordinating with cloud provider. No confirmed ETA; next update in 30 minutes."

emma-oncall: Agreed. Also record for postmortem: check route validation guardrails, improve early detection thresholds to avoid cascading eviction spikes.

support-agent: Posting update to customers now.

sam-net: Cloud NOC reports partial route restore. Seeing prefixes return. Continued monitoring for flapping.

jia-sre: Observing decreasing eviction and error rates in ap-southeast3 as routes return, but we’ll keep failover policy for a bit until stability confirmed.

emma-oncall: Closing initial triage. We’ll keep this incident channel open for updates. Please add notes to the incident doc and assign postmortem owner after stability. :white_check_mark:
